ja: 玄関の鍵、閉めたか思い出せない。
en: I can't remember if I locked the door.
alternatives: I can't remember whether I locked up.
I don't remember if I locked the door.
point: 「〜かどうか」は if か whether。語順は平叙文

ja: これ拭くもの、何かある？
en: Do you have something to wipe this with?
alternatives: Is there something I can wipe this with?
Got anything I can wipe this with?
point: something の後ろに to 不定詞。前置詞 with を残す

ja: 彼女がうんと言ってたら、今ごろ食洗機があるのに。
en: If she'd said yes, we'd have a dishwasher now.
alternatives: If she'd agreed, we'd have a dishwasher by now.
If she'd agreed to it, we'd have a dishwasher now.
point: 過去の仮定は had + 過去分詞、今の結果は would have

ja: ついでに、窓も拭いておいたよ。
en: I did the windows while I was at it.
alternatives: I cleaned the windows while I was at it.
While I was at it, I wiped the windows.
point: 「ついでに」は while I was at it で言える

ja: 一番上の棚に届かないんだ。
en: I can't reach the top shelf.
alternatives: I can't reach the highest shelf.
The top shelf is too high.
point: 一番上の棚は特定の棚なので the top shelf と the をつける

ja: 誰かがブレーカーを落としたのかも。
en: Someone might have tripped the breaker.
alternatives: Maybe someone tripped the breaker.
Someone could have tripped the breaker.
point: かもしれない過去は might have + 過去分詞

ja: 弟はもうアイロンがけできるよ。
en: My brother can iron now.
alternatives: My brother can iron clothes now.
My brother can already iron.
point: can の後ろは動詞の原形で irons にしない

ja: 帰る前に、おもちゃを片付けておいてね。
en: Pick up the toys before you leave.
alternatives: Put the toys away before you leave.
Clean up the toys before you go.
point: 片付ける は pick up / put away / clean up で言う

ja: 洗濯機、朝からずっと回りっぱなしだよ。
en: The washer's been running since this morning.
alternatives: The washing machine has been running all morning.
The washer has been going since morning.
point: 「ずっと〜してる」は have been + ing、起点は since

ja: 洗濯機が壊れたって聞いたよ。
en: I heard the washing machine broke.
alternatives: I heard that the washer broke down.
I heard our washer stopped working.
point: heard の後の that は省ける。壊れた出来事は過去形

ja: 玄関の脇の箱、僕が片付けたよ。
en: I put away the box by the door.
alternatives: I've put away that box by the door.
The box by the door? I put it away.
point: 「玄関の脇の箱」は box の後ろに by the door

ja: 疲れてても、自分のお椀はすすいでね。
en: Even if you're tired, please rinse your bowl.
alternatives: Even when you're tired, please rinse your bowl.
Tired or not, please rinse your bowl.
point: 「〜てても」は even if。although にしない

ja: お皿、ためないほうがいいよ。
en: You shouldn't let the dishes pile up.
alternatives: You shouldn't leave the dishes piled up.
Don't let the dishes pile up.
point: 「ためる」は let 〜 pile up。助言は shouldn't

ja: フィルター、先月から掃除されてないよ。
en: The filter hasn't been cleaned since last month.
alternatives: Nobody has cleaned the filter since last month.
The filter hasn't been cleaned for a month.
point: since があるので現在完了の受動 hasn't been cleaned

ja: あなた、今週ずっと靴下を床に脱ぎっぱなしだよ。
en: You've been leaving socks on the floor all week.
alternatives: You've been leaving your socks around all week.
You keep leaving your socks on the floor.
point: 「ずっと〜してる」は現在完了進行形 have been -ing

ja: 掃除、ちょっと休憩しよう。
en: Let's take a break from cleaning.
alternatives: Let's stop cleaning for a bit.
Let's give cleaning a break.
point: 「〜しよう」は Let's + 動詞の原形。「休憩する」は take a break

ja: 土曜、みんなでガレージを掃除するよ。
en: We're cleaning the garage this Saturday.
alternatives: We're going to clean the garage Saturday.
We'll clean the garage this Saturday.
point: 決まった予定は現在進行形でも言える

ja: 兄は先週の日曜、午後ずっと草むしりしてたよ。
en: My brother spent all last Sunday afternoon pulling weeds.
alternatives: My brother was weeding all last Sunday afternoon.
My brother spent last Sunday afternoon weeding the yard.
point: 「〜して過ごした」は spent + 時間 + -ing の形

ja: 弟に部屋を片付けるよう言ってくれる？
en: Can you tell him to clean up?
alternatives: Could you tell him to tidy up?
Can you ask him to clean up?
Will you tell him to clean up?
point: tell + 人 + to do の語順。that 節にしない

ja: お母さん、牛乳がもうないよ。
en: Mom, there's no milk left.
alternatives: Mom, there isn't any milk left.
Mom, we have no milk left.
Mom, we're out of milk.
point: milk は数えられないので a をつけず no milk とする

ja: ゴミ袋を買い足すの、忘れないでね。
en: Don't forget to buy more trash bags.
alternatives: Remember to buy more garbage bags.
Please don't forget to get more trash bags.
point: forget to 〜 は「〜し忘れる」。これからする行為

ja: 先週、うちはエアコンを業者に掃除してもらった。
en: We had the AC professionally cleaned last week.
alternatives: We got the AC professionally cleaned last week.
We had a pro clean the AC last week.
point: have + もの + 過去分詞で「〜してもらう」

ja: リサイクル、出してもらってもいい？
en: Do you mind taking out the recycling?
alternatives: Could you take out the recycling?
Would you mind taking out the recycling?
point: mind の後は動名詞。to take にしない

ja: 洗濯物を干す前に、天気予報を見ればよかった。
en: I wish I'd checked the forecast first.
alternatives: If only I'd checked the weather first.
I should have checked the forecast first.
point: 過去の後悔は wish の後を過去完了 I'd checked にする

ja: 私が皿洗いの間、弟はモップがけしてた。
en: While I washed dishes, my brother was mopping.
alternatives: My brother was mopping while I washed dishes.
While I did the dishes, my brother mopped.
point: while の節は過去形、同時に続いていた動作は過去進行形 was mopping

ja: 私が昨日掃除したのに、もう散らかってる。
en: I cleaned yesterday, but it's a mess already.
alternatives: I cleaned yesterday, and it's messy again.
I cleaned it yesterday, but it's already messy.
point: 昨日は過去形、今の状態は現在形で言い分ける

ja: 一緒にガレージを片付けたいなと思ってて。
en: I was hoping we'd clean out the garage.
alternatives: I was hoping we could clean out the garage.
I was thinking we could clear out the garage.
point: I was hoping で控えめに誘う。中身ごと片付けるは clean out

ja: プールがあったら、僕は掃除ばかりだよ。
en: If we had a pool, I'd be cleaning nonstop.
alternatives: I'd be cleaning nonstop if we had a pool.
If we owned a pool, I'd clean it constantly.
point: 現実と違う仮定は if + 過去形、主節は would

ja: ねえ、掃除機がどこにあるか知ってる？
en: Do you know where the vacuum is?
alternatives: Any idea where the vacuum is?
Do you know where the vacuum cleaner is?
point: 間接疑問は where the vacuum is の語順

ja: 嫌なのは洗濯じゃなくて、皿洗いのほうなんだよね。
en: It's the dishes I can't stand, not the laundry.
alternatives: What I can't stand is the dishes, not the laundry.
It's doing the dishes I hate, not the laundry.
point: 「嫌なのは〜」は It's ~ (that) で強調し、not で対比する

ja: 洗濯物を干すベランダ、そろそろ掃除する頃だよね。
en: It's about time we cleaned the balcony where we hang laundry.
alternatives: It's time we cleaned the balcony where we hang laundry.
It's about time we cleaned the balcony we hang laundry on.
point: It's about time の後ろは過去形（今すべきだという含み）

ja: 家事を公平に分けるため当番表を作ったよ。
en: I made a chart to split chores fairly.
alternatives: I made a chart to divide chores evenly.
I made a schedule to share chores fairly.
point: 「〜するために」は to + 動詞の原形

ja: 僕らが早く電話してれば、お湯が使えたのにね。
en: If we'd called sooner, we'd have had hot water.
alternatives: If we'd called earlier, we'd have had hot water.
We would've had hot water if we'd called sooner.
If we'd called sooner, we could've had hot water.
point: 過去の仮定は if 節が had + 過去分詞、主節は would have

ja: 私、まだ洗う皿があるんだ。
en: I still have dishes to wash.
alternatives: I still have some dishes to do.
I have more dishes to wash.
point: 「洗う皿」は dishes to wash。名詞のあとに to + 動詞

ja: ごめん、今、洗濯物たたんでるとこ。
en: Sorry, I'm folding the laundry right now.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm folding laundry at the moment.
Sorry, I'm busy folding the laundry.
point: 「〜してるとこ」は現在進行形。right now と相性がいい
